chapter: New York dance bands and Dorsey
title: Leaving Ray Noble; Glenn Miller's drinking
summary: Freeman spent eighteen months with Noble; a drunk Glenn Miller warned Ray about 'a bad British band', and later stopped drinking with his own band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: But I must say, it was a great musical experience, Ray was a fine musician and he was a gentleman.
How long were you with him?

I was with him 18 months. There was a very funny story about the ending of that. You see, the main number of them were being let out, or were a group leaving for other offers and Glenn Miller got very drunk one night and he said, 'You know, Ray, if you're not careful, they are going to be saying, here come the British with a [bad, bad band.']
That was a funny thing to see, you know, when Glenn Miller got his own band, he completely stopped drinking and became quite the disciplinarian and of course, became a tremendous success.
I knew he did, but I didn't know he was a very heavy drinker.
Oh, he was a big drinker in those days, oh yes, [good heavens, oh many years.]
